Chapter 1348: 25: Slaying The Da Feng Emperor

Chapter 1348: Chapter 25: Slaying the Da Feng Emperor

“Rebellion?”

The white-haired third uncle seemed a bit confused.

The more he knew, the clearer it was just how powerful the Da Feng Dynasty was.

After experiencing governance by six wise rulers, the Da Feng Dynasty was like oil boiling over a raging fire, at the peak of its prosperity.

Is this the time to start a rebellion?

Let’s not speak of other matters.

Can they withstand the overwhelming suppression of Da Feng’s massive army?

The soldiers of the Da Feng Dynasty are one in a thousand, selected from every thousand ordinary citizens for enlistment.

One hundred million people in a state, barely enough to piece together a million regular troops.

But precisely because of this, the military strength of the Da Feng Dynasty is extremely robust.

It also forged the legend of a thousand troops being able to encircle and kill an Entering Dao Master.

There is indeed the help of various weapons and arms that suppress Spiritual Power.

But it also has a lot to do with the army itself.

“Yes.”

The figure kneeling on the ground quickly turned around and left.

It was clear they were going to prepare for the ‘rebellion’.

Lin Yuan sat there casually, his gaze deep and distant.

Ever since he quietly took control of the Golden Dragon Sect, over the past fifty years.

The forces he established have been developing rapidly.

Apart from the traces detected by the Tao Suppression Department.

For example, nine of the top ten merchant associations in the world are related to Lin Yuan.

In fact, there’s a larger portion hidden underwater.

The intelligence seen by the Tao Suppression Department Chief was all what Lin Yuan wanted him to see.

The so-called top ten merchant associations were all established by Lin Yuan.

Even though the imperial merchants of the Da Feng Dynasty have been infiltrated by Lin Yuan almost entirely.

And the control over the major states? The Tao Suppression Department Chief only found out about more than thirty states.

However, nearly seventy out of ninety-nine states in the world are completely under Lin Yuan’s control.

The remaining thirty-some states, even if Lin Yuan cannot fully control, he can still influence greatly.

Even in the capital state, Central State, Lin Yuan has placed many of his own people.

The only place he cannot grasp is the imperial palace.

The Imperial Guard in the Da Feng palace have been cultivated over generations.

With ancestors going back three generations as Imperial Guards, trying to infiltrate them?

As difficult as climbing to the sky.

If given two hundred or three hundred years, it wouldn’t be impossible for Lin Yuan.

But he doesn’t have that much lifespan, having descended to this cyclical world, Lin Yuan confirmed he could live at most one hundred and fifty years.

This is limited by the rules of the world, or the supreme rules that permeate the Endless Dimensional Planes, Lin Yuan cannot break them either.

Or rather, he cannot break them by relying solely on his own power; if he expends the World-Breaking Origin Force, he could live longer.

But there’s no need.

…

Overall.

With control over most of the power in the world’s ninety-nine states, Lin Yuan is fully capable of challenging and even overthrowing the Da Feng Dynasty.

The only thing to dread is the foundation within the palace.

However, it doesn’t have much impact.

In countless views of future timelines.

Lin Yuan has basically figured it out almost entirely.

In the multiple views of future timelines earlier, he saw a high-probability timeline where he could even kill the Emperor of Da Feng.

…

Outside Black Mountain.

Dozens of generals stood outside the camp, gazing at the unfathomable Black Mountain.

At this moment.

A pigeon with black feathers flew over.

It landed on the shoulder of the leading general.

“This?”

The leading general opened the note tied to the pigeon’s leg, scanned it, and his expression changed subtly.

“Gentlemen.”

The leading general glanced at the other dozens of generals.

These generals came from several major surrounding states and were the true commanders currently besieging all entrance and exit points of Black Mountain.

As for the more than twenty Entering Dao Masters of the Tao Suppression Department?

They can only command these generals and thus control the army.

If all the generals refuse to comply, the Entering Dao Masters of the Tao Suppression Department won’t have much to do.

The military deployment involves all aspects; it’s not just about strength.

Most Entering Dao Masters are immersed in exploring and cultivating Spiritual Power, with little experience in commanding armies in combat.

In fact, the Da Feng Dynasty is very wary of Entering Dao Masters commanding the military.

Originally, an Entering Dao Master has terrifying individual power, able to capture an enemy general amidst thousands of soldiers.

The only thing that can somewhat suppress and restrain Entering Dao Masters is massive troop encirclement.

If Entering Dao Masters were allowed to command the army? What would happen then?

The power structure of the Da Feng Dynasty has precautions against Entering Dao Masters.

Even those Entering Dao Masters nurtured by the dynasty are restricted in several aspects.

“General.”

“What’s wrong with the General?”

Dozens of generals looked at the lead general and asked.

This time, the mobilization of seven or eight hundred thousand troops nearly drained all the available forces of several major states.

Indeed, theoretically, a major state can train a million troops.

But these million troops are usually stationed in various places, and at most, only one to two or three hundred thousand can be mobilized.

“There are treacherous ministers causing chaos in the court, are you willing to join me in storming the palace, executing these traitors, and restoring order to the land?”

The leading general’s tone was calm, but his expression left no room for doubt.

Silence.

The scene instantly fell into dead silence.

Most of the generals exchanged glances, their eyes faintly showing strangeness.

A few of the generals were incredulous, clearly shocked by the lead general’s words.

Storm the palace?

Execute traitors?

How could they not know?

“Ruan Qingchuan, do you dare to rebel?!”

A few breaths later, a burly general stepped forward, looking at the lead general with anger.

In today’s Da Feng Dynasty, the Emperor is the absolute sovereign? Treacherous ministers?

What treacherous minister could sway the Emperor’s will?

Treasonous ministers causing chaos?

The Emperor could kill a minister with just a word.

Is there a need for local armies to take action?

And storm the palace?
